title: neural network-based prediction of smtp errors and bounces in cold emailing: a comparative study of gru, cnn, and tcn
core_idea: Compare GRU, CNN, and TCN neural network architectures on a cold email dataset to predict SMTP errors and bounces, with the goal of improving email delivery and managing sender reputation.
tldr: A comparative study of GRU, CNN, and TCN models to predict SMTP errors and bounces in cold emailing, aimed at optimizing delivery and sender reputation.
